title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.13889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM AP

translated_title: RATED：基于执行动态的可靠性感知AI智能体工具检索
translated_abstract: 随着AI智能体日益依赖外部工具，准确的工具检索对于实现可靠行为至关重要。现有方法仅优化语义相关性，却在很大程度上忽略了执行期间工具的可用性。为填补这一空白，我们提出了RATED（基于执行动态的可靠性感知工具检索），这是一个将鲁棒语义匹配与动态可靠性自适应相结合的检索框架。RATED采用经对比微调的冻结双编码器进行语义匹配，并利用一个轻量级的上下文多臂老虎机模块，基于实时执行反馈对候选工具进行重排序。这一设计使系统能够快速适应运行时工具故障，而无需昂贵的模型重新训练。我们还引入了EcoAgent基准，包含5,172个真实世界工具和超过21万个查询-工具对，用于离线检索与动态可靠性评估。实验结果表明，RATED相比ToolLLM API实现了52.2%的相对MRR提升。
tldr: RATED通过冻结双编码器进行语义匹配，并用轻量级上下文老虎机模块根据实时执行反馈重排序候选工具，无需模型重训即可快速适应运行时工具故障，同时提出含5,172个真实工具的EcoAgent基准，实现52.2%的相对MRR提升。
